title: How big is a 1 carat radiant?

hook.text: How big is a 1 carat radiant?

post.youtube_title: How big is a 1 carat radiant?
post.caption:
A 1 carat radiant measures about 6.5 by 5.0 millimeters. A 2 carat radiant covers 38% of the width of a size 6 finger.

Radiant diamond size chart: https://www.heygema.com/en/gem-size/radiant-diamond-size-chart?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=gem_size_shorts

Estimates for a well-cut stone.
